title_sq: Ne Qender ,Shiten Dy Apartamente Ideale Per Investim!!
description_sq: Ne Qender, Shiten Dy Apartamente Ideale Per Investim!! Prona ndodhet ne katin e 7-te te nje pallati te mireadministruar me ashensor dhe organizohet ne apartament 1+1 dhe garsoniere. Apartamentet kane lokacion ideal per investim per qira ditore ose mujore pasi kerkesat per qira jane shume te larta. Pronat jane totalisht te mobiluara dhe jane perdorur per qira ditore. Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: In the center, two apartments for sale, ideal for investment!!
description_en: In the center, two apartments for sale, ideal for investment!! The property is located on the 7th floor of a well-managed building with an elevator and is organized into 1+1 apartments and studios. The apartments have an ideal location for investment for daily or monthly rent as the rent requirements are very high. The properties are fully furnished and are used for daily rent. The property has regular mortgage documentation.
